verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a business-banking SaaS, since banking platforms can expose APIs for scripted use. The evidence only shows in-app automation: auto-transfer rules, approval rules, recurring invoices, and accounting syncs. It also shows Plaid connectivity, which is a host or third-party building block. None of this amounts to a documented way to run Relay headlessly or from CI, and one community report says external payments still have to be executed manually.
